1.

Lord, Thy countenance Thou dost not hide from me, Though not clearly through the clouds I see Thee.

C.

O Thou my faithful, precious Redeemer, Comest Thou not soon? Yea, Thou comest soon.

2.

Through Thy saving grace I have become Happy to be a stranger on earth.

3.

Keep Thou my heart only fast to the one thing, Content to possess Thee, Lord, alone.
